scope: Analysis 2 and 3 (14 files): HEK293 Flp-In T-REx WT vs CARNMT1 KO, SDS-PAGE gel regions

claims.evidence: PRIDE lists a single raw_files.7z (RAW) plus 20 .mgf; the 7z central header was range-read and its 20 top-level .d folders map 1:1 to the .mgf names and to sample ids in the docx. Split across four SDRFs by PEAKS search project.
PRIDE instrument field, protocol text and paper: nanoElute + timsTOF Pro.
Protocol: data-dependent mode, top 10; experimentTypes DDA.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance]

claims.evidence: Not stated in deposit or paper.
Paper: Flp-In T-REx 293 (TRex) cells; Cellosaurus CVCL_U427 maps to BTO:0006149 'Flp-In-T-REx cell'. Sex female / fetal kidney from Cellosaurus.

claims.value: WT vs CARNMT1 knockout, per fraction/gel region
claims.evidence: docx sample table pairs each KO and WT file by compartment and kDa region.
docx lists LysC for the RNF113A-GFP samples (Analysis 3); PRIDE protocol prose says trypsin only.
docx search projects 2 and 3; propionamidation of in-gel digested samples; monomethylation of His = UNIMOD:34.
Proteins separated by SDS-PAGE and gel region excised.

limitations: Four SDRFs because the five PEAKS search projects use different fixed/variable modifications (build supports one modification set per file); Analyses 2 and 3 are merged since their modification sets are identical and enzyme is a per-row column.
Raw data are one 56 GB raw_files.7z; names were read from its header, not downloaded. Instrument model and dissociation not verified from analysis.tdf; dissociation left not available.

Cell line term is the BTO label 'Flp-In-T-REx cell'; the Cellosaurus name/accession columns carry the exact identity. Sex female from Cellosaurus, not the deposit. Which KO clone (#1-#3) each sample used is not stated.
Culture medium, passage number, storage temperature, disease, cell type, age not stated: not available.
RNF113A-GFP samples are GFP-Trap immunoprecipitates from transfected cells (not encoded as a column).
Lys-C for 14508/14510 comes from the deposited docx; reconcile flags it against PRIDE prose (trypsin) - docx is more specific.
C. elegans organism part 'whole body' is an assumption: nuclei-enriched fraction prepared from whole-worm pellets. Strain N2 triggers an ontology warning (not in NCBITaxon).
Modification target for Amidated in the in vitro file is C-terminal (PP=Any C-term) while the docx says amidation of Ile.
